psychological_meaning: Firefly evokes feelings of tranquility and mystery, reminiscent of twilight nights illuminated by gentle, glowing insects. It suggests sophistication and introspection, blending the stability of darker hues with a hint of enchanting luminance. It is often associated with calm confidence and a subtle, understated elegance.
